item.description:
Release v5.8.3

Changes since v5.8.2

  • bugfix: fix a bug
  • feat(ActivityHeatmap): localize chart strings
  • feat(app-store-promo): add HTML promotional artwork designer
  • feat(AppIconDesigner): add app icon assets and configure AppIcon for AppIconDesigner target
  • feat(AppIconDesignerPlugin): add PreviewIconTool for visual inspection
  • feat(AppStoreConnectPlugin): configure ViewContainer panel visibility
  • feat(AppStoreConnectPlugin): register ViewContainer for the main view
  • feat(BookletMaker): add app icon assets and configure AppIcon for BookletMaker target
  • feat(BookletMaker): add demo PDF support, drop zone UI, and duplex sheet explanations
  • feat(BookletMaker): add original and converted stage tabs to explanation view
  • feat(BookletMaker): add standalone BookletMaker app target
  • feat(BookletMaker): explain duplex sheets in the UI
  • feat(BookletMaker): move drop area to sidebar and fix localization
  • feat(BookletMaker): rename to PDF Tools and add page-range splitting
  • feat(BookletMaker): split output into physical sheets and print sides
  • feat(BookletMaker): support renaming individual split PDF outputs
  • feat(CADDesigner): add app icon assets and configure AppIcon for CADDesigner target
  • feat(CI): configure Xcode Cloud for AppIconDesigner
  • feat(computer-use): add always-on UI automation plugin
  • feat(ComputerUsePlugin): localize UI and error strings via LocalizationKit
